$comment: Preset 'inline-workers' for installer/init.mjs (--preset inline-workers). HAND-MAINTAINED (unlike the derived presets): the /tmp/gen-presets.mjs generator is not in-repo, so regeneration would drop this file. The inline delegation family — the inline plan executor plus the 4 inline decision-tree skills and their knowledge-skill dependency closure (the closure rides preset membership for the knowledge skills; the 4 workers + plan-execution-inline-skill are ALSO covered by dependency-map.json requiresSkills edges), plus the reviewer baselines the /run-worktree-pipeline-v2 inline-review arm names explicitly and the code-review checklist's core knowledge skills. Opt-in: default setup.sh deploy is unaffected.
name: inline-workers
description: Inline delegation family — plan-execution-inline-skill, the testing/linting/documentation/responsive-audit inline skills, the knowledge skills they defer to, and the reviewer baselines for inline pipeline reviews (reviewer-baseline-skill, language-review-checklists-skill). Companion to the /run-plan-v2 and /run-worktree-pipeline-v2 commands on full deploys.
